player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} a odi {colour} ({piece}) wɔ Othello agorɔ mu.
Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛnya wo kɔla no pii sen biara wɔ agorɔ no awiee.
Wo bɛto wo kɔla no sɛ ɛbɛfa wo pɛpɛfo no kɔla pii wɔ kwan no fa biara (kwan tenten, kwan trɛw, anaa kwan mɔkrɔ) wɔ wo kɔla foforɔ ne wo kɔla a na ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no ntam. Pɛpɛfo no kɔla pii a wɔbɛfa no bɛdan wo kɔla.
Fa wo kwan wɔ '[row, col]' nhyehyɛeɛ mu.

board.no_valid_moves_reset: {observation} Akwan a ɛmfata biara nni hɔ - ebia ɛsɛ sɛ wotwe wo ho.
board.no_valid_moves_step: {observation} Akwan a ɛmfata biara nni hɔ. Ebia ebehia sɛ wotwe wo ho fi mu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔfã no yɛ [row, col].

game_action.skipped: Ɔbɔadeɛ {pid} no antumi ankɔ ne bere so.

game_message.must_skip: Player {pid} ({piece}) nni kwan a wɔbɛfa na ɔbɛskipi.
